title: OldAnimations
body:
OldAnimations

With over 100+ configuration options to customize the user experience, AxolotlClient's OldAnimations mod completely emulates the visuals and feel of Minecraft 1.7.10 within 1.8.9! Additionally, this mod features integration with [AxolotlClient]().
Features

Features include:

- Sword blocking visuals and functionality - Sneaking related visuals - Various item/block related changes - Old texture/model rendering - Combat related features such as armor tint - GUI adjacent features such as changes to the player list or debug overlay - Enchantment glint rendering - Miscellaneous and niche changes

Features not included:

- The ability to mine blocks while also using items - Removing the attack cooldown on missed hits
Motivation ### Why? ### Many mods have tried to bring back 1.7.10 features, but none have delivered a complete experience. This mod goes beyond surface-level changes. It transforms GUIs, item rendering, combat feel, and countless other niche details to authentically recreate the 1.7.10 experience that players loved.
Disclaimers ### Disclaimers We do not endorse nor support cheats/hacks. This mod aims to be compliant with 1.8 behavior. If you feel like one or more options packaged by this mod could be regarded as one of the above, please let us know and we'll try our best to prevent people from using them on affected servers.
Credits ### Credits This mod exists thanks to the dedication of some fantastic testers who helped iron out every bug and ensure a seamless experience. Because this mod is based off of some of my previous work in Animatium Legacy (formerly OverflowAnimationsV2), Animatium, and Sol Client, I would like to shout out Wyvest, ImToggle, Redth, TheKodeToad, Tellinq, and lowercasebtw for their past and continuous contributions to those amazing mods.
Need assistance? Feel free to join the [discord server](https://discord.gg/WyMjeX3vka) or [open an issue](https://codeberg.org/AxolotlClient/OldAnimations/issues).
